title: a failing available, item or successor still destroys the cursors and their resources once
purpose: Observe failure, cleanup and lifetime ordering during execution.

stdout.text:
fail available: +r0 use r0 +r1 -r0 -r1 caught
fail item: +r0 use r0 +r1 -r0 -r1 caught
fail successor: +r0 use r0 +r1 -r0 use r1 -r1 caught

provenance.origin: authored for #483/#484 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: #483/#484: a failure in a cursor action unwinds the step that owns the cursor: its resource is destroyed before the handler runs.
